channel.title: Containerd on History
channel.description: Recent content in Containerd on History

item.title: Kukie Serving.05 Cold Start Path
item.description: Where the minutes go between a start button and a ready vLLM pod on a fresh GPU node — the engine image pulled into the node’s root EBS on every new node, the weights kept on a separate PVC EBS that outlives the node, and a 65GB read that ran at exactly the gp3 baseline of 125 MiB/s.

item.title: Network & K8s.03-1 A Process in a Room
item.description: What a container actually is on an Ubuntu VM — three problems that VMs and containers each solve, the runtime stack from dockerd and kubelet down to runC, why runC vanishes and containerd-shim stays as the parent, the six namespaces and one cgroup directory seen through /proc.

item.title: CRI / containerd
item.description: kubelet 과 컨테이너 런타임 사이의 규격(CRI)과, 그 규격을 구현한 대표 런타임(containerd). 실제 컨테이너는 그 아래 runc 가 만든다.
